# A13 - catalogue generation and the debug APK

Date: 2026-11-13. One item: the generated Kotlin catalogue.

## Catalogue

`apps/android/core/src/main/kotlin/com/hopa/catalog/AppCatalog.kt` starts with
"Generated by tools/scripts/build-app-catalog.py. Do not edit by hand." CI runs
`python tools/scripts/build-app-catalog.py --check`, so a stale commit fails.

## Debug APK (not a release)

- `hopa-0.1.0-debug.apk`, 61 155 282 bytes,
  sha256 `6F32A242A7ED92ACF287B0FFE67D402CCC5D31DCA3FA6C8E6BC5433960157FE3`,
  commit `4b90fef`, installed and run on the `hopa35` emulator.
- Signed with the debug key only. No release keystore, no `keystore.properties`,
  no Android release note in `docs/project/releases`.
